name: Due diligence failure

subjectOf.text: Funds of funds claimed to select the best managers through skilled due diligence and charged standard 2 and 20 fee structures for that service, while in reality depositing the vast majority of their capital into Madoff's opaque fund.
subjectOf.abstract: and investment analysis practices and then in return charged their investors standard private fund fee structures (2/20).139 In reality, most of these funds were depositing the vast majority of their capital into Madoff's black box of a fund.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811718
scope_conditions: Madoff feeder funds and funds of funds before December 2008

subjectOf.text: Because Madoff overtly disallowed scrutiny of his secretive and unconventional practices, it was impossible for feeder funds such as Rye to perform the due diligence they had represented to investors.
subjectOf.abstract: Again, it was impossible for a fund like Rye to perform due diligence as Madoff overtly disallowed such due diligence of his extremely secretive and unconventional practices.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811718

subjectOf.text: Expert testimony identifies recurring failures in private fund due diligence, including the absence of any written policy or process to ensure compliance and reliance on individuals with little or no experience, particularly with the particulars of hedge funds.
subjectOf.abstract: Major failures or red flags in private fund IDD among private fund advisers include: (1) a lack of written policy or processes in place to ensure compliance;236 (2) the individual conducting the due diligence having little to no experience (especially on the particulars of hedge funds);
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Investor Due Diligence – Evidence from 1995 to 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811718
scope_conditions: expert reports in the surveyed litigation record
